summary: Open-source B2B SaaS and protocol stack for luxury product authentication with Digital Product Passports, GS1 Digital Link, decentralized identifiers, and ERC-3643 compatible blockchain infrastructure.

statusLegend.shipped: Implemented in the repository and covered by at least typecheck/lint or documented tests.
statusLegend.partially_verified: Implemented, but at least one runtime or environment-dependent verification could not be completed locally.
statusLegend.in_progress: Implemented in part, with a known missing dependency or follow-up before full production use.
statusLegend.planned: Roadmapped or documented, but not implemented as an end-user feature yet.

features.name: Secure cookie authentication
features.description: Email/password registration and login with httpOnly access and refresh cookies, refresh token rotation, logout, current-user introspection, and no browser localStorage token storage.
verification: api tests require local PostgreSQL credentials
features.verificationJustification: Register/login/setup, authenticated dashboard persistence, refresh retry, and unauthenticated API guards are covered by Playwright plus API auth tests.

features.name: RBAC and brand-scoped authorization
features.description: ADMIN, BRAND_ADMIN, OPERATOR, and VIEWER roles gate sensitive actions, while product and webhook data is scoped by brandId for non-admin users.
features.verificationJustification: Role and brand-scope rules are covered across API integration tests for products, webhooks, audit, upload, mint, transfer, recall, and security hardening; no dedicated browser role matrix exists.

features.name: CSRF protection for mutating API calls
features.description: POST, PATCH, PUT, and DELETE flows require the X-Galileo-Client header, and the dashboard central API helper sends it automatically.
features.verificationJustification: CSRF header behavior is covered by API integration tests and unauthenticated Playwright API checks; dashboard sends the header through the shared API helper.

features.name: Sign-In With Ethereum
features.description: SIWE login issues one-time 5-minute nonces, verifies wallet signatures, supports wallet-only sessions, and integrates with the dashboard wallet authentication flow.
features.verificationJustification: Playwright covers linked-wallet SIWE login through the dashboard, and API tests cover nonce, signature, replay, and Smart Wallet cases.

features.name: Wallet linking
features.description: Authenticated users can link an Ethereum wallet through nonce-protected EIP-191 signature verification, including Smart Wallet compatible verification paths.
features.verificationJustification: Wallet-link nonce and signature flows are covered by API integration tests and Playwright API checks; there is no full browser wallet-link UI test.

features.name: GDPR data export and erasure
features.description: Users can export account data under GDPR Article 15 and request erasure under Article 17, with audit-safe actor handling for deleted users.
features.verificationJustification: API tests cover export and erasure; Playwright now covers the settings page and JSON download, but the destructive browser erasure path is intentionally not executed end-to-end.

features.name: Product registry and Digital Product Passport authoring
features.description: Brand admins create, list, edit, and view products with GTIN validation, serial numbers, luxury categories, DID generation, passport metadata, material composition, and brand-scoped access.
features.verificationJustification: Playwright covers product creation, identity checkpoint, listing, sorting, filtering, and detail navigation; API tests cover validation and brand scoping.

features.name: Product lifecycle state machine
features.description: Products move through DRAFT, MINTING, ACTIVE, TRANSFERRED, and RECALLED states with guarded dashboard actions, optimistic mint concurrency, recall confirmation, and ownership transfer handling.
features.verificationJustification: Playwright covers DRAFT creation, draft editing, mint confirmation, and transfer; API tests cover mint, transfer, recall, concurrency, and state guards.

features.name: Product image upload
features.description: Brand operators can upload product imagery through multipart API handling and persist image URLs for passport display and scanner verification.
features.verificationJustification: Playwright covers media controls, upload, replacement, persistence, and mobile visibility; API tests cover MIME, permissions, deterministic CID, and replacement cleanup.

features.name: CSV batch import
features.description: CSV import supports validation-first product ingestion up to 500 rows, row-level errors, dry-run semantics, material composition validation, and dashboard feedback.
features.verificationJustification: Playwright covers CSV preview, dry-run validation, commit, invalid rows, and multiline CSV; API tests cover transaction semantics and access control.

features.name: Batch minting
features.description: Brand admins can mint up to 100 DRAFT products in one batch with per-product result reporting and lifecycle constraints.
features.verificationJustification: Batch minting now has a dedicated dashboard Playwright flow: draft products are selected from the product list, minted through the UI, and verified as active in the browser.

features.name: GS1 Digital Link resolver
features.description: Public resolver serves product passports at /01/{gtin}/21/{serial}, normalizes GTINs to 14 digits, validates check digits, and emits JSON-LD DPP data.
features.verificationJustification: Resolver behavior is covered by API integration tests and Playwright API checks; scanner browser tests cover invalid input paths, not a full active-product resolver page.

features.name: QR code generation
features.description: Authenticated users can generate product QR codes that encode the GS1 Digital Link URL for scanner and consumer verification flows.
features.verificationJustification: QR generation now has a dedicated dashboard Playwright flow: an active product detail page downloads the QR PNG and verifies the generated filename.

features.name: Consumer scanner PWA
features.description: Consumer-facing scanner app supports QR scanning, GS1 deep links, authenticity result pages, provenance timeline display, material composition, and PWA installation assets.
features.verificationJustification: Playwright covers scanner home, Digital Link form, invalid DID/URL/GTIN handling, and camera permission-denied states.

features.name: Scanner offline cache
features.description: Scanner service worker caches app shell and previously loaded verification pages to keep critical verification information available offline.
features.verificationJustification: Playwright covers scanner app shell and scan page offline behavior, plus strict offline replay of a previously loaded ACTIVE product verification deep link after service worker activation.

features.name: Audit trail and export
features.description: Append-only audit log records sensitive actions and supports paginated dashboard review plus CSV/JSON export with date filtering.
features.verificationJustification: Audit creation, filtering, role access, CSV/JSON export, and unauthenticated denial are covered by API integration and Playwright API checks; dashboard audit browsing is not separately E2E-tested.

features.name: Transfer compliance checks
features.description: Ownership transfers run compliance checks for jurisdiction, sanctions, brand authorization, certified pre-owned status, and service center eligibility before changing state.
features.verificationJustification: Playwright covers create, mint, and transfer to a valid address; API tests cover compliance rejection and module-level transfer rules.

features.name: Webhook outbox and signed deliveries
features.description: Brands can create webhook subscriptions for lifecycle events. Delivery records are persisted in PostgreSQL, signed with HMAC-SHA256, retried with exponential backoff, and isolated by brand.
verification: pnpm test with dedicated Galileo PostgreSQL
features.verificationJustification: Webhook CRUD, stats, delivery queue, signing, retry backoff, brand scoping, and event enqueue are covered by API integration tests.

features.name: Webhook monitoring dashboard
features.description: Dashboard lists webhook subscriptions, displays live queue metrics, creates and deletes endpoints, shows per-subscription pending/failing deliveries, and exposes manual retry for in-flight events.
verification: pnpm test with webhook API coverage
features.verificationJustification: Playwright now covers the Webhooks dashboard, stats cards, subscription creation, one-time secret dialog, detail navigation, retry action visibility, and empty delivery queue.

features.name: Health probes and structured logging
features.description: API exposes health diagnostics for database and blockchain connectivity and uses structured Pino logging with PII redaction and production-safe configuration.
features.verificationJustification: Health responses and logging behavior are covered by API tests and Playwright API health checks; production log drains are not externally verified.

features.name: Sentry error tracking
features.description: Error tracking configuration is present for API runtime monitoring and is represented in tests and environment validation.
features.verificationJustification: Sentry configuration behavior is covered by unit tests when no DSN is configured; no real Sentry event capture is exercised.

features.name: ERC-3643 contract suite on Base Sepolia
features.description: Foundry contracts model ERC-3643 token, identity registry, trusted issuers, claim topics, access control, and compliance modules, with Base Sepolia deployment metadata recorded.
features.verificationJustification: Contract source and deployment metadata are present, Foundry build plus 738 contract tests pass via an isolated Foundry binary, and a live Base Sepolia constructor-path mint deployed GalileoCompliance 0x688e071B5C7C09c7A9aA6fF0fdd204AD8a7a95Ee plus GalileoToken 0x11ef46e76ae5fbd0b14e29ac7b1fd93ad5eA01F9 in tx 0x9cca203f8c3d988ac79bd5ea5c17cfd23a76d0d1393f32e0fb0f82875ccbc026.

features.name: Live blockchain minting service
features.description: API service can deploy or issue ERC-3643 product tokens through viem and recorded Base Sepolia infrastructure, with live Base Sepolia minting verified through the product token deployment script.
features.verificationJustification: Blockchain service fallback behavior is unit-tested, API configuration accepts the canonical RPC env plus legacy alias and wallet credentials from ignored environment files, deploy bytecode is embedded for Docker/runtime availability, and a live Base Sepolia mint deployed token 0x11ef46e76ae5fbd0b14e29ac7b1fd93ad5eA01F9 with balanceOf(deployer)=1, totalSupply=1, expected product DID/GTIN/serial, and compliance binding.

features.name: Scanner on-chain verification badge
features.description: Scanner can display blockchain verification context for products, including chain-related passport data surfaced by API verification responses.
features.verificationJustification: Scanner chain context now has browser coverage with a real ACTIVE product resolved through the scanner UI, asserting verified status, blockchain proof, chain, token address, and provenance.

features.name: Base Sepolia developer faucet
features.description: Public faucet tooling lets developers request rate-limited Base Sepolia ETH for testing mint and transfer flows, with status endpoint and website UI.
features.verificationJustification: Faucet request behavior is now covered by API tests for status, successful drip, wallet rate limiting, disabled faucet, missing wallet configuration, and invalid address errors.

features.name: Public gas estimator
features.description: Website tool estimates testnet operation costs for product minting, transfer, and recall so builders can forecast Base Sepolia usage.
features.verificationJustification: The website gas estimator page lints and builds; no interaction-level browser test covers estimator calculations.

features.name: Documentation website
features.description: Public documentation portal covers quick start, architecture, compliance, identity, token concepts, governance, specifications, blog posts, and legal pages.
features.verificationJustification: Documentation pages lint and build successfully; content correctness is reviewed as documentation rather than tested behavior.

features.name: Public changelog and roadmap
features.description: Public pages expose the project changelog and roadmap, including Base ecosystem positioning, release history, and future protocol phases.
features.verificationJustification: Changelog and roadmap pages lint and build successfully; they are content pages without browser flow tests.

features.name: CI and release automation
features.description: GitHub Actions run workspace checks, Playwright configuration is present, changesets support release notes, and pnpm/action-setup has been updated to v6.
features.verificationJustification: Workflow and changeset files are present, but GitHub Actions execution was not run inside this local audit.

features.name: Deployment configuration
features.description: API has a production Docker/Railway setup with Prisma ESM patching and health checks, while dashboard, scanner, and website have Vercel configuration.
features.verificationJustification: Application builds pass with deployment configs present; Railway/Vercel deployment execution itself is not exercised locally.

features.name: Enterprise multi-tenant workspace isolation
features.description: Future work covers database row-level security, workspace-scoped routing, refined roles, team invites, MFA, API keys, and background job tracking.
features.verificationJustification: This remains roadmap-only and is not implemented as a product feature.

features.name: T1 token economy and governance
features.description: Future protocol phase covers T1 utility token launch, gas abstraction, payment options, LEOX migration, staking, treasury governance, and buy-back-and-burn mechanics.
features.verificationJustification: This remains roadmap-only and is not implemented as a product feature.

features.name: Base Mainnet scale and independent security audit
features.description: Future production hardening includes independent smart contract security audit, mainnet deployment, compliance scaling, and operational maturity before broad adoption.
features.verificationJustification: This remains roadmap/security-policy planning and requires future independent audit and mainnet deployment.

verificationLevels.e2e_browser: A real Playwright browser scenario covers the principal user-facing flow for this feature.
verificationLevels.live_testnet: A real testnet transaction verifies the principal blockchain flow on the target network.
verificationLevels.api_integration: API or integration tests cover the behavior, but the principal user-facing browser flow is not fully covered.
verificationLevels.unit: Unit tests cover core logic, but API/browser integration is incomplete or not applicable.
verificationLevels.static_build: The implementation is verified by typecheck, lint, or production build only.
verificationLevels.documented_only: The item is represented by documentation, plans, manifests, or configuration, with no executable verification in this audit.
